description: The set-up of the OF1 case in small: cfd_3d_6dof_net_sheet_collar (floating thin-walled collar, net sheet X 320 4 below it) with four catenary mooring lines (X 310 1, X 311), the mesh refinement around the body (G 1 1, the zone G 12 0.15, G 7 0) and the one-step scheme with two projections (N 40 6), 2 ranks: level 0 advances the body with the midpoint rule and the loads of the patches, the mooring forces and the net forces; the net forces on the fluid are spread onto the patches as well (before, the fluid of a patch did not feel the net).
covers: cfd_amr::step_comp: N 40 6 with floating bodies (the stages 0 and 1 of the bodies on level 0 and on the patches)
mooring_Catenary with the mesh refinement and N 40 6
cfd_amr zone of the body (G 12) on 2 ranks
